name: A King's Tribute
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron.  Such a shame the land is in such shambles.

But the Memorial came out quite well! I should think the King will be most pleased with it.

Now if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The granite seems but a small token compared to a great dwarf's life. But no dwarf shall last on this planet for eternity.

Let us just hope that the memorial stands as a reminder to those who will trod the great Azeroth of the future. Lest we not forget it is for them that brave soldiers such as Sully Balloo so valiantly gave their lives.
